items.text: After being capped, present yourself before your mother and give her a share of the ceremonial food, bowing as you invite her to accept it.
items.quote: he takes the dried flesh, presents himself before his mother. The mother bows on receiving the flesh, the son bowing as he invites her to accept it.

items.text: Visit your aunts in the side apartments with the same respectful forms as when visiting your mother.
items.quote: When he goes into the side apartments to visit his aunts and elder sisters he uses the same forms as when visiting his mother.

items.text: Visit your elder sisters with the same respectful forms as when visiting your mother.
items.quote: When he goes into the side apartments to visit his aunts and elder sisters he uses the same forms as when visiting his mother.

heading: Yili 1 · Shi Guan Li 士冠禮 · The Capping of an Ordinary Officer's Son (Steele, chapters I-II) · Shi Guan Li II.19 · Regarding Shoes … Fotiv Notes

items.text: When your son comes of age, have him capped with the prescribed hats and shoes.
items.quote: The heir is capped at the head of the eastern steps

items.text: Bear the style given at your capping so as to honor the name your parents gave you.
items.quote: The giving of the Style following upon the capping is meant to keep in honour the name he got from his parents.

items.text: As the heir, accept your capping at the eastern steps, showing you are to succeed your father.
items.quote: The heir is capped at the head of the eastern steps to make clear the fact that he is to succeed his father.

items.text: If you succeed to your father's rank, imitate his ability to rule.
items.quote: A man is permitted to succeed to his father as feudal duke in the expectation that he will imitate his father in his ability to rule.

items.text: Arrange and conduct the capping ceremony for your son, to mark his passage into manhood.
items.quote: I have a son ... who is about to be endued with the black cloth cap

items.text: Go to see your mother after the capping, taking dried flesh to present to her; if she is absent, send someone to receive it on her behalf.
items.quote: Then the graduate faces north, and, taking the dried flesh, goes to see his mother.

items.text: If a young man is fatherless, arrange the capping guests and ceremony for him in place of his father.
items.quote: If the graduand is an orphan, the apprising and bidding of the guests are done by one of his uncles or an elder brother.

items.text: If your younger brother is fatherless, arrange the capping ceremony for him in your father's place.
items.quote: If the graduand is an orphan, the apprising and bidding of the guests are done by one of his uncles or an elder brother.

items.text: Practice filial piety and keep it to the utmost.
items.quote: Filial piety and brother love are at their best. See that you keep them so.

items.text: Maintain brotherly love and keep it to the utmost.
items.quote: Filial piety and brother love are at their best. See that you keep them so.

heading: Yili 1 · Shi Guan Li 士冠禮 · The Capping of an Ordinary Officer's Son (Steele, chapters I-II) · Shi Guan Li I.1 · Divining for the Day … Meeting the Principal Guest

items.text: Carry out his capping ceremony at the proper time, with all the required rites and preparations.
items.quote: They then set out the clothes for the graduand under the west wall of the east chamber

items.text: Divine for an auspicious day for the capping in the doorway of the ancestral temple.
items.quote: The divining (with the stalks) is carried on in the doorway of the ancestral temple.

items.text: Divine to select the principal guest three days before the ceremony.
items.quote: Three days before the date fixed for the ceremony they divine concerning the man selected to be the principal guest

items.text: Go in person to invite the principal guest and receive him with the proper bows and courtesies.
items.quote: The Master of Ceremonies goes in person forthwith to bid the principal guest.

items.text: Submit to the capping ceremony your father has arranged, standing ready as instructed.
items.quote: The graduand, in coloured clothes, and with his hair tied together, stands in the chamber with his face southward.

items.text: Attend the capping ceremony and take your place with the father to show family support.
items.quote: The Master of Ceremonies stands to the east of the door, with his brothers and cousins to the south of him

items.text: Hold the capping ceremony in the ancestral temple, thereby showing honor to the ancestors.
items.quote: On the eve of the day the time is fixed outside the door of the temple.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration as divine service conflicts with exclusive worship of God (Exodus 20:3-5)
